display.purpose: Uppercase hairline (200) titles over hero scrims; clamp 2.6rem to 5rem.

headline.purpose: Page headings outside detail heroes; weight 300.

kicker.purpose: Tracked uppercase section labels (Overview, Cast, More Like This).

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, cast names; weight 500.

shadows.name: media-lift
shadows.purpose: Poster plates and floating panels on the dark ground.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary amber CTA; deepens on hover to 0 16px 32px -8px rgba(245,165,36,0.6).

motion.name: hero-drift
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: detail hero backdrop settles behind static content. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: micro-lift
motion.purpose: Hover lifts on buttons and cards.

motion.name: image-scale
motion.purpose: Rec-card poster zoom inside its clipped plate.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber pill CTA; accent-ink text, tinted shadow, hover lift. One per viewport region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.6rem; background:#f5a524; color:#1c1302; font-weight:600; font-size:.95rem; border:0; border-radius:9999px; padding:.85rem 1.9rem; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 10px 26px -8px rgba(245,165,36,.55); transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1), box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 16px 32px -8px rgba(245,165,36,.6); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f5a524; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: 3rem translucent circle for secondary actions; requires aria-label.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:3rem; height:3rem; border-radius:9999px; background:rgba(217,231,238,.08); border:1px solid rgba(217,231,238,.2); color:#d9e7ee; font-size:1.2rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgba(217,231,238,.16); border-color:rgba(217,231,238,.4); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f5a524; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Genre Chip
components.description: Transparent pill link; hover borders amber with a faint amber fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; padding:.45rem 1.1rem; border-radius:9999px; border:1px solid rgba(217,231,238,.22); color:#8fb3c4; font-size:.8rem; text-decoration:none; transition:border-color .2s, color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#f5a524; color:#d9e7ee; background:rgba(245,165,36,.08); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f5a524; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Translucent field on the dark ground with an amber focus ring.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="q">Search</label><input class="ds-input" id="q" type="text" placeholder="Search titles, people…" />
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:rgba(217,231,238,.08); border:1px solid rgba(217,231,238,.15); border-radius:.75rem; padding:.6rem 1rem; color:#d9e7ee; font-size:1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#8fb3c4; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f5a524; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-label { display:block; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:500; color:#8fb3c4; margin-bottom:.4rem; }

components.name: Poster Plate
components.description: Image plate: radius, translucent outline, heavy soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-plate { border-radius:.75rem; overflow:hidden; outline:1px solid rgba(217,231,238,.14); box-shadow:0 24px 48px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7); } .ds-plate img { display:block; width:100%; }

components.name: Fact List
components.description: Key/value detail rows separated by hairline lines.
components.css: .ds-facts { list-style:none; display:grid; gap:.9rem; font-size:.95rem; padding:0; margin:0; } .ds-facts li { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; border-bottom:1px solid #133a4d; padding-bottom:.9rem; } .ds-facts .k { color:#8fb3c4; } .ds-facts .v { color:#d9e7ee; font-weight:400; text-align:right; }

components.name: Kicker Heading
components.description: Tracked uppercase section label; replaces bold section headings.
components.css: .ds-kicker { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8fb3c4; margin:0 0 1.2rem; }

narrative.overview: Flix is a dark, image-forward cinema catalog. Every screen sits in projection-booth darkness deepened from the original brand teal, so TMDB imagery carries all visual weight. Chrome recedes: nav floats over imagery on gradient scrims, sections are labeled with tracked kickers, and depth comes from layered translucency on one ground color. A single amber accent is reserved for the primary action, the rating, and active/brand punctuation; secondary text is always teal-tinted, never gray. Reference render: docs/design-concepts/concept-a-projection-room.html.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed backdrop heroes under layered ground-colored scrims
Single dark ground; surfaces are translucent overlays or ramp steps
One amber accent with a strict three-job reservation
Teal-tinted secondary text; no neutral grays on the dark ground
Hairline uppercase display type; tracked uppercase kickers

rules.name: The Three-Job Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only as primary action, rating, and active/brand punctuation. A fourth job requires removing one of the three.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: On the dark ground every gray is teal-tinted (text-muted or an rgba of the text color). Tailwind gray/slate/zinc utilities are banned in new code.

rules.name: The Hairline Title Rule
rules.body: Large titles use weight 200 and uppercase transform; hierarchy is weight and size contrast, not color.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text never sits on raw imagery; a ground-colored gradient scrim always mediates, strong enough to keep AA at the text position.

dos: Do put imagery under every hero and let the scrim system carry legibility.
Do tint all secondary text and translucent chrome from the teal/text family.
Do reserve amber for its three jobs and use accent-ink (#1c1302) for text on amber.
Do keep the two-radius system (0.75rem / 9999px) and 3rem icon-button hit targets.
Do ship visible :focus-visible amber rings on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use Tailwind gray/slate/zinc utilities on the dark ground.
Don't introduce a second accent or use amber decoratively.
Don't place text on raw imagery without a scrim.
Don't use pure black or pure white as surfaces or text.
Don't reintroduce daisyUI classes or Font Awesome; icons are inline SVG (lucide-react).
